name: Stackup construction validity
description: Structural validity of the declared layer stack: copper and dielectric must alternate, both outer surfaces must be copper, layer names must be unique, and thickness/Er values must be physically plausible. Every other stackup check assumes a well-formed stack; this is the check that verifies it. Requires a design-data stackup; not evaluable from bare Gerbers.
what_it_measures: Count of structural faults in the ordered layer stack (0 when the stack is a physically possible build).
